## Escalation Best Practices  
### When to Escalate  
**Escalate Immediately If:**
- Financial impact exceeds your approval limit
- Regulatory/compliance implication
- Reputational risk
- Customer relationship at risk
- You lack authority/expertise
- Issue is unclear/complex
- Unresolved after 24 hours
name: Chunk 14/22

raw_entities.name: Escalation Best Practices
raw_entities.description: A procedural guideline defining the conditions and triggers that mandate immediate escalation of banking operational issues. The process establishes seven distinct escalation criteria covering financial, regulatory, reputational, and operational dimensions.
context: Financial impact exceeds your approval limit

raw_entities.name: Financial Impact Approval Limit Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers escalation when the financial impact of an issue exceeds the decision-maker's delegated approval authority. This is the first escalation criterion in the best practices framework.
context: Financial impact exceeds your approval limit

raw_entities.name: Regulatory or Compliance Implication Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers escalation when an issue carries regulatory or compliance implications. This ensures that matters with potential regulatory exposure are elevated to appropriate authority.

raw_entities.name: Reputational Risk Assessment Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers escalation when an issue poses reputational risk to the organization. This ensures visibility and management of matters that could affect the bank's public standing or brand.

raw_entities.name: Customer Relationship Risk Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers escalation when an issue threatens the customer relationship. This ensures that matters affecting customer retention or satisfaction receive appropriate management attention.

raw_entities.name: Authority and Expertise Sufficiency Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers escalation when the handling officer lacks the necessary authority or expertise to resolve an issue. This ensures that complex or specialized matters are directed to qualified personnel.

raw_entities.name: Issue Clarity and Complexity Assessment Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers escalation when an issue is unclear or complex. This ensures that ambiguous or multifaceted matters receive appropriate senior review before resolution.

raw_entities.name: Resolution Timeout Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that triggers escalation when an issue remains unresolved after 24 hours. This ensures that stalled matters are elevated to prevent further delay and customer impact.

properties.purpose: Define criteria and triggers for escalating issues within banking operations
properties.scope: All operational issues requiring escalation decision

properties.decision_question: Does the financial impact exceed the actor's approval limit?
properties.criteria: Comparison of transaction or issue financial value against actor's delegated authority limit
properties.path_no: Proceed with resolution at current level

properties.decision_question: Does the issue have regulatory or compliance implications?
properties.criteria: Presence of potential breach, violation, or regulatory reporting obligation
properties.path_yes: Escalate immediately to compliance or regulatory authority

properties.decision_question: Does the issue pose reputational risk to the organization?
properties.criteria: Potential for public disclosure, media attention, or brand damage
properties.path_yes: Escalate immediately to senior management or communications

properties.decision_question: Is the customer relationship at risk?
properties.criteria: Potential for customer dissatisfaction, churn, or relationship deterioration
properties.path_yes: Escalate immediately to relationship manager or senior authority

properties.decision_question: Does the actor possess sufficient authority and expertise to resolve the issue?
properties.criteria: Actor's delegated authority level and technical or domain expertise match issue requirements
properties.path_yes: Proceed with resolution at current level
properties.path_no: Escalate immediately to higher authority or specialist

properties.name: Issue Clarity and Complexity Assessment Gate

properties.decision_question: Is the issue clear and within standard complexity parameters?
properties.criteria: Issue is well-defined, documented, and falls within routine operational scope
properties.path_no: Escalate immediately for clarification and specialized handling

properties.decision_question: Has the issue remained unresolved for more than 24 hours?
properties.criteria: Time elapsed since issue identification exceeds 24-hour threshold
properties.path_yes: Escalate immediately to next authority level
properties.path_no: Continue resolution efforts at current level
